nodes.label: YooKassa Payout Sandbox-only Mode (YOOKASSA_PAYOUT_MODE)
nodes.rationale: Live payout mode fails closed until separate card/SBP/bank_account payloads are implemented and certified; sandbox mode uses a local mock provider payout id to avoid uncertified real payouts.

nodes.label: ProMapsViewSimple Recreation Fix (stable ValueKey)
nodes.rationale: ProMapsViewSimple.didUpdateWidget() already handles coordinate updates, so keying the widget by coordinates caused unnecessary full recreation (~150ms per GPS update); a constant key avoids recreation while updates still propagate via didUpdateWidget.

nodes.label: Timer.periodic to AnimationController Migration (offer countdown)
nodes.rationale: Timer.periodic at 50ms ticks caused 200 setState() calls per 10-second countdown (20fps rebuild rate); replacing with a vsync-driven AnimationController + AnimatedBuilder preserves exact timing while eliminating setState-driven rebuilds.

nodes.label: Riverpod select() Optimization on newDriverProvider
nodes.rationale: Watching the entire provider state caused rebuilds on any state change; select() on workState/availableOrders/isLoading/stats reduces rebuilds by ~60% by only reacting to relevant field changes.

nodes.label: Startup Performance Optimization (removed deferFirstFrame, shorter splash)
nodes.rationale: deferFirstFrame() blocked startup by 800ms; removing it and reducing splash delay from 1400ms to 900ms improves perceived startup time (~46% faster to meaningful content).
nodes.norm_label: startup performance optimization (removed deferfirstframe, shorter splash)

nodes.label: Map Rendering Performance Optimization (RepaintBoundary, CachedNetworkImage sizing)
nodes.rationale: RepaintBoundary around map tiles/markers and reduced marker shadow blur/alpha lower GPU load, addressing map rebuild storms.
nodes.norm_label: map rendering performance optimization (repaintboundary, cachednetworkimage sizing)

nodes.label: Navigation Performance Optimization (RepaintBoundary + faster transitions)
nodes.rationale: RepaintBoundary around AnimatedSwitcher and shortened/adjusted transition curves reduce jank during screen transitions.

nodes.label: Provider.select() Granular State Watching
nodes.rationale: Selective providers for pickupLocation, dropoffLocation, uiState, estimatedPrice reduce unnecessary rebuilds from broad provider watching.

nodes.label: AnimatedButton Performance Optimization (RepaintBoundary, elasticOut curve)
nodes.rationale: Curve change from bounceOut to elasticOut improves 120Hz performance and touch feedback responsiveness.

nodes.label: Driver Screen Performance Optimization (RepaintBoundary per IndexedStack child, mounted checks)
nodes.rationale: Mounted checks prevent state updates on unmounted widgets, addressing memory leak risk from timers.
nodes.norm_label: driver screen performance optimization (repaintboundary per indexedstack child, mounted checks)

nodes.label: Theme Loading Optimization (removed runtime GoogleFonts call)
nodes.rationale: Runtime GoogleFonts.manrope() call was blocking; replaced with const string reference to avoid synchronous font loading delay.
nodes.norm_label: theme loading optimization (removed runtime googlefonts call)
